caption:
33 facilities: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres leads India in the Coloprice ranking of operators by tracked facilities.

Nxtra Data follows with 26, then NTT Global Data Centers with 20, Sify Technologies with 19 and CtrlS Datacenters with 16. India has 310 tracked facilities across 86 operators.

Facility count is not capacity: CtrlS publishes 252 MW from 16 sites, more than Nxtra Data (234 MW from 26). Largest by tracked facilities, not an endorsement.

Data: Coloprice operator rankings, 11 Nov 2026. Sources on the last slide.
